main_text.head: COROLLARIUM AUCTORIS,
main_text.p: ANnon ex usu Ecclesiæ foret, Candidatos Ministerii etiam admittere ad Conventus Ecclesiasticos, ut Auditores? Sicut in senatu Romano, olim Senatorum filiis licuit, Sueton. in Augusto cap. 38. libris Senatorum, quò celerius R. P. assuescerent, curiæ interesse permisit. Et apud Judæos in summo Senatu Jerosolymitano, Sanhedrin etiam Candidati sedebant. Mischana Sanhedrin cap. 4. §. 4. וג שרות של תח Tres discipulorum, sive Candidatorum ordines coram illis sedebant. Quibus vel licuit aliquando interpellare, quod nos docet Moses Mikkotzi præc. aff. cvii. גם תלמיד etiam discipulus sedens coram judice, si videat innocentiam pauperis, & culpam divitis, tacere haud debet. Aff. prout Theologi Zelandi judicabant in Synodo Dordrac. Sess. xviii.

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "A" is joined to "Nnon" as "ANnon". The Hebrew and Greek-style forms (שרות של תח, גם תלמיד) are copied as printed and may be imperfect. Passage numbers are printed as in the original. The catchword "ERRA-" and the signature-like mark "* 4" appear at the foot; the page number 4 is the printed number.
